questions.text: A direct mapped cache memory of 1 MB has a block size of 256 bytes. The cache has an access time of 3 ns and a hit rate of 94%. During a cache miss, it takes 20 ns to bring the first word of a block from the main memory, while each subsequent word takes 5 ns. The word size is 64 bits. The average memory access time in ns (round off to 1 decimal place) is______.
questions.solution:
Block = 256 bytes = 32 words of 8 bytes.
Miss penalty = first word 20 ns + 31 more words [latex]\times[/latex] 5 ns = 175 ns.

Average access time = hit time + miss rate [latex]\times[/latex] miss penalty = [latex]3+0.06\times175=3+10.5=13.5[/latex] ns.

(If cache access is counted only on hits: [latex]0.94\times3+0.06\times175\approx13.3[/latex], which the official key also accepts.)

Answer: 13.5

Other Answer as per GATE 2020 Answer Key : 13.3 to 13.3 or 13.5 to 13.5

Row 3 = {16, 17, 18, 19, 20} [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] a[3][3] = 19.

Answer: 19

questions.text: Consider a double hashing scheme in which the primary hash function is [latex]h_1(k)=k\; mod \; 23[/latex], and the secondary hash function is [latex]h_2(k)=1+(k\; mod \; 19)[/latex]. Assume that the table size is 23. Then the address returned by probe 1 in the probe sequence (assume that the probe sequence begins at probe 0) for key value k=90 is_____________.
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- [latex]h_1(90)=90\bmod23=21[/latex]
- [latex]h_2(90)=1+(90\bmod19)=1+14=15[/latex]

Probe i = [latex](h_1+i\cdot h_2)\bmod23[/latex]. Probe 1 = [latex](21+15)\bmod23=36\bmod23=13[/latex]

Answer: 13

questions.text:
Consider the following grammar.

[latex]S\rightarrow aSB|d[/latex]
[latex]B\rightarrow b[/latex]

The number of reduction steps taken by a bottom-up parser while accepting the string [latex]aaadbbb[/latex] is___________.
questions.solution:
Reductions while parsing aaadbbb bottom-up:
1. d [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] S
2. b [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] B, 3. aSB [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] S
4. b [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] B, 5. aSB [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] S
6. b [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] B, 7. aSB [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] S

Answer: 7

questions.text: Assume that you have made a request for a web page through your web browser to a web server. Initially the browser cache is empty. Further, the browser is configured to send HTTP requests in non-persistent mode. The web page contains text and five very small images.The minimum number of TCP connections required to display the web page completely in your browser is__________.
questions.solution:
Non-persistent HTTP uses a separate TCP connection for each object: 1 for the HTML page + 5 for the images.

Answer: 6
